description: T-3348: Gate A fresh sweep for RATE (decision 0188 R2, R4.2): 300 ordinary annuities with fv != 0 and one root in (-1, inf), guess omitted, type 0/1, drawn per stratum (typical 120: rate 1E-3 to 0.2, nper 12 to 480; tail/edge 90: nper 1-3 or 900-1000, rate near 1E-6 or 1, fv or pv near 0; extreme 60: nper 100 to 1000 at pv and fv 1E5 to 1E12, the region where the secant stalled; log-uniform 30: rate 1E-6 to 1, nper 1 to 1000, pv and fv 1 to 1E12). pmt is the payment of the drawn rate cut to 15 digits; each label ends in math=, the 50-digit mpmath root of the cell's literal inputs (dps 60 checked at dps 80), until SPEC-0029's math sidecars land.
